notes: These are required engineering constraints. They are not claimed to be automatically enforced until CI/release integration is implemented.

rules.rule: MasterProfile creation MUST NOT create a second Account.
SellerProfile creation MUST NOT create a second Account.
Authorization MUST use effective backend capabilities.
Cross-context writes MUST go through the verified owner contract.
Each mutable business entity MUST resolve to one owner after factual inventory.
New business actions MUST NOT be added directly to api/db.php.
New frontend business code MUST NOT introduce direct fetches to legacy api/db.php.
A feature MUST NOT be promoted to READY without required evidence.
Legacy code MUST NOT be removed until replacement usage and regression safety are proven.
Agent MUST identify factual domain evidence, target owner and invariants before implementation.
Unverified ownership MUST be labeled TARGET_UNTIL_VERIFIED and MUST NOT be presented as canonical fact.
